author: Too_Pale
quote: For its time, Ocarina of time was an absolute masterpiece and revolutionised 3D Action Adventure games on consoles. The gameplay even to this day feels smooth and fluid and easy to pick up, with a controller that's as confusing as it is straight forward. Ocarina of Time would go on to retain the highest rating of all time for almost 30 years, before being beat out by Grabd Theft Auto 6 being positively review bombed before its release in order to become the top spot. Ocarina of Time finally losing its top spot goes to show that honesty and integrity in game journalism has become about paying for fake reviews, and dishonest reviews from game journalists. Never forget Ocarina of Time earned number 1, GTA VI bought it.
